hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.css|*.json|*.md) npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in *.env|*.env.local|*.env.example) echo 'BLOCKED: .env files contain real API keys and secrets. Edit these files manually in your editor.'; exit 2 ;; esac
